完整原題

題目二： Amber 段考前一晚，打電動到很晚，根本沒準備考試科目。請根據這些圖片寫一篇至少 50 字的段落文章。 圖一：Amber 在深夜仍打電動。 圖二：考試時她顯得疲倦，無法專心。 圖三：老師宣布收卷，Amber 尚未完成，感到驚慌。
先想一想，再查看答案、解說與原圖
原卷作答：完整原作見下方逐句訂正
參考範文（超過 50 字）：
The night before the exam, Amber played video games until very late and did not study. The next morning, she felt so tired that she fell asleep during the test. When the teacher asked everyone to hand in their papers, Amber had not finished hers. She regretted staying up late and promised herself that she would prepare well next time.

詳細說明與解題步驟

一、先把三張圖串成事件
打電動熬夜 → 考試疲倦 → 來不及完成與後悔。這是發生在過去的故事，主要敘事動詞採過去式。

二、原作全文（依照片與原對話交叉核對）
The day before the exam, Amber played video game too late, so she didn’t prepare her exam. Then on the day of the exam, she was very tired, even slept during the exam. Finally, she didn’t finish her exam. She was very worried and regret about it. She swear that she never do again.

三、逐點訂正
1. played video game → played video games：這裡以複數概括遊戲活動；若指一款遊戲，須用 played a video game。
2. too late 可表示過遲；若要強調玩到深夜，until very late 更清楚。
3. prepare her exam → prepare for her exam：prepare for 表示為考試準備；prepare an exam 可能是準備一份考卷。
4. very tired, even slept → very tired and even fell asleep：用 and 連接，fall asleep 表達睡著。
5. regret about it → regretted it／regretted staying up late：regret 直接接受詞，並配合過去時態。
6. swear → swore；never do again → would never do it again：轉述過去立下的承諾。

四、檢查字數與指涉
至少 50 字，不只列三個短句；hers 指 Amber 的考卷，next time 清楚表達未來改善。

① 前一晚熬夜玩遊戲，沒準備考試

The night before the exam, Amber played video games until very late and did not study. 先交代時間與原因；played video games概括玩遊戲，prepare for an exam是為考試準備。

② 隔天疲倦，考試無法專心

The next morning, she felt very tired and could not focus on the test. felt與could表過去；先依圖中打呵欠，寫疲倦、不專心這個結果。

③ 收卷時還沒寫完，把前後事件連起來

When the teacher asked everyone to hand in their papers, Amber had not finished hers. When連接老師收卷的時刻；hers代Amber的考卷。

④ Amber看圖寫作：先寫原因，再寫結果與反思

結尾示例：She regretted staying up late and promised herself that she would prepare well next time.

  • 上面三句加本格結尾，可連成60字的參考段落，超過50字。
  • 主線採過去敘事；When連接收卷時刻，前後指涉要清楚。
  • 可用後悔與下次改善作合理結尾；regretted staying up late直接接動名詞。
